Supplier catalogue showing a broad part family — Modbury

Authored fictional teaching supplement for Adelaide; linked incident ACI-V2-2026-0009, Modbury.
A fictional supplier catalogue repeats ADL-CORE-05 as a part-family code for several compatible assemblies. It is not a unique serial number. A matching catalogue family does not establish that two observations concern the same physical part.
These newly authored details are a synthetic comparison exercise, not quotations from the original incident report.
